scope: Lesson and Practice handwriting board bug hunt

findings.title: Live OCR route returns empty text for clear common math expressions
findings.expected: Clear math images for equations and trigonometric expressions return recognized text or at least non-empty alternatives for learner review.
findings.actual: 3/5 live OCR calls returned HTTP 200 from a provider but `accepted=false` with empty text.
findings.repro: POST generated PNG data URLs for common math expressions such as `2x+3=9` and `sin30=1/2` to `/api/handwriting-recognition`.

findings.rootCause: The route/provider acceptance threshold or post-processing may be dropping usable OCR candidates instead of surfacing them for learner review.
